resources.string: Copy this report after a failed connection or format switch. It contains phone and capture status details, not video or keyboard input. It is kept only for this app session and is not uploaded automatically.
Local preview only. No recording or uploads.
Use your phone as a display
1. Connect the HDMI output of your computer to HDMI IN on the capture card. If needed, use a USB-C to HDMI adapter that supports video output.
2. Connect the USB side of the card to an Android phone with OTG support. Enable OTG in phone settings if required.
3. Allow camera and USB access, then connect. Select mirroring in the computer display settings to see the same desktop, or move a window onto the extended display.
Black screen or color bars? Check HDMI, display settings and power. Frames from the card do not guarantee a working HDMI signal.
Pinch to zoom and drag to inspect details. Double-tap to reset zoom and position. Open Keyboard for Bluetooth input on Android 9+. Audio and recording are not supported.
Direct UVC capture on iPhone is not supported.
Includes UVCAndroid 1.0.13 and native video components. Their licenses are bundled with the APK.
No UVC video device found. Check OTG, cables and power.
Connect a card to see its supported formats. For USB 2.0, start with 720p / 30 fps.
This device does not report USB Host support. Use a phone that supports OTG.
Camera permission is needed for USB video
Allow access to the card in the system dialog
USB connected. Waiting for frames from the capture card.
Connect HDMI output to the capture card,\nthen connect the card to your phone
Capture card unplugged. Reconnect it to resume.
Preview will resume when you return to the app.
Camera permission is required for USB video. Try again or enable it in app settings.
The selected card is no longer connected. Reconnect it and try again.
Video did not start. Trying a lower format (%1$d/2)…
USB access was denied. Tap connect and allow access in the system dialog.
Cannot open the USB device. Close other capture apps and try again.
USB authorization failed. Unplug and reconnect the capture card.
Cannot start video. Check the capture card or reconnect.
The video component could not load on this device. Report your phone model and Android version.
No video frames. Automatic retries have stopped. Check HDMI and USB power, or select a different format.
Could not read licenses. See the third-party notices in the repository.
Choose a capture card and one of its supported formats.
Make Pocket Monitor work your way.
Capture-card compatibility and latency require real-device testing.
Use this phone as a Bluetooth keyboard and touchpad for your computer. Video still uses the capture card.
Requires Android 9+ and Bluetooth HID Device support.
Allow Nearby devices to connect a computer.
Connection unavailable. Check Bluetooth and try again. This phone may not support HID Device, or another keyboard app may be using it.
Pair in system Bluetooth settings first, or make this phone discoverable and add it from the computer. Then refresh and select that computer here. Keep the app in the foreground.
No paired devices yet. Pair your computer first.
Android 9+; device compatibility needs testing. Input stops in the background: enable and connect again on return. BIOS / pre-boot input is not supported.
Tap a modifier keycap or select it below, then tap a key for a shortcut. Selected modifiers light up and clear after one shortcut. ⌥ is Option; ⌘ is Command.
Up to 200 ASCII characters, using US keyboard positions. Select a matching layout on the computer. For Chinese, use its input method. Text is sent without modifiers.
Use English letters, numbers and standard punctuation. Chinese and emoji cannot be sent directly.
Slide to move · Tap to click
Touch down to press; lift or slide away to release. Use multiple fingers for shortcuts. Up to 6 ordinary keys plus modifiers.
Swipe the keyboard sideways to reach all keys. Landscape gives more room.

If Mac asks for the key immediately to the right of left Shift, press Z. For the key to the left of right Shift, press /. Choose ANSI (US) if asked. Follow the wording on your Mac; these are position keys, without Shift.
Layout and colors based on Keychron C1/K2, Akko 5087B and Varmilo Sea Melody.
Fn layer: arrows → Home / End / PgUp / PgDn; Backspace → Del; Del → Ins. Tap Fn again to exit.
